ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to the multiple ways computers are used in music, with an emphasis on digital sounds synthesis and composition. Elements of acoustics, psychoacoustics, and programming are introduced in order to allow students to use and modify the existing software DISSCO/Sound Maker developed at UIUC. Students are required to bring a laptop to class. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
